newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgarian budget deficit tops '96 target by 93 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bulgarian budget deficit tops '96 target by 93 pct.

text.p: Bulgaria's central government budget deficit totalled 155.4 billion levs as of November 30, or 192.5 percent of the annual target in the unrevised budget, Finance Ministry figures showed.
BULGARIA BUDGET DEFICIT, bln levs NOV 30 NOV 17
REVENUE 278.6 255.6
pct of annual target 77.8 71.4
EXPENDITURE 433.9 353.4
pct of plan 98.9 80.5
pct of plan 192.5 121.1
"The deficit rose due to large interest payments on the quickly increasing domestic debt," a Finance Ministry official told Reuters.
Interest payments on Bulgaria's domestic debt totalled some 230 billion levs for the first 11 months, topping the annual target by 21 percent, the official said.
The sharp depreciation of the lev against the dollar also caused a rise in the deficit because it boosted the lev denomination of foreign debt payments.
Bulgaria's parliament on Friday tentatively approved a budget revision, this year's second, which includes a 115 billion lev loan to the government to cover domestic debt payments.
Under the revised budget, which is expected to have a final reading this week, 117 billion levs are earmarked for interest and maturity payments on domestic debt.
Domestic debt grew to 668.3 billion levs at the end of October from 345.4 billion levs at the beginning of the year.
The government wants the deficit target raised to 204.2 billion levs or five to six percent of GDP from 80.7 billion levs or 4.9 percent of GDP to meet higher domestic debt payments.
Some 6.3 billion levs are slated for foreign debt payments.
The Bulgarian National Bank's central interest rate is now set at 15 percent monthly or 180 percent annually.
The lev slumped to around 365 per dollar at the end of November from 270 at mid-November.

Bulgaria's parliament in July revised the budget to meet high foreign and domestic debt payments and attempt to keep structural reform on track, raising the deficit target from 58.3 billion levs to 80.7 billion levs.
